subject: mempalace
tagline: Local-first AI memory. Verbatim storage, pluggable backend, 96.6% R@5 raw em LongMemEval, zero API calls.

capabilities.name: Verbatim storage (sem paraphrase)
capabilities.description: Armazena conversas verbatim em drawers, principio inegociavel no CLAUDE.md

capabilities.name: Wings/Rooms/Drawers hierarchy
capabilities.description: Estrutura de memoria por pessoa/projeto (wing), dia/sessao (room), conteudo verbatim (drawer)

capabilities.name: Pluggable storage backends
capabilities.description: Interface abstrata, ChromaDB default, outros backends drop-in

capabilities.name: Hybrid BM25 + vector search
capabilities.description: Okapi-BM25 re-rank sobre candidates vector, IDF sobre corpus fornecido

capabilities.name: Temporal knowledge graph (SQLite)
capabilities.description: Entities + typed predicates + valid_from/valid_to em SQLite local

capabilities.name: AAAK compression dialect
capabilities.description: Compressao simbolica do index layer, LLM scan rapido

capabilities.name: 29 MCP tools
capabilities.description: Palace reads/writes, knowledge graph, cross-wing nav, agent diaries

capabilities.name: LongMemEval R@5 96.6% raw
capabilities.description: 96.6% R@5 raw, 98.4% R@5 hybrid v4 held-out, sem LLM; reproducivel

capabilities.name: Entity detection + registry
capabilities.description: Auto-detect pessoas/projetos com disambiguation por DOB/ID/context

capabilities.name: L0-L3 wake-up stack
capabilities.description: Camadas de memory injection com budget <100ms startup

unique_selling_points: Verbatim always: politica nao-negociavel de nao summarizar, nao paraphrase, retornar palavras exatas
100% local-first: zero API calls no caminho core, 96.6% R@5 sem LLM em nenhum estagio
Benchmarks reproduziveis: LongMemEval 96.6% raw + 98.4% held-out, LoCoMo 88.9% hybrid v5, MemBench 80.3%
Temporal knowledge graph em SQLite (vs Zep Neo4j cloud): free, local
Performance budgets explicitos: hooks <500ms, startup injection <100ms

limitations.description: ChromaDB file lock no Windows reduz coverage (85% -> 80%)
Benchmarks publicados mas sem comparacao side-by-side contra Mem0/Zep (por decisao explicita de honestidade)
